notes.title: BANANO BROS. v1.2
notes.content:
Here you are new features of this version:


- 19 new achievements.

- New enemy.

- Fixed difficulty: it was sometimes too difficult or unfair.

- When you respawn after dying  you are invencible for a short time.

- Visual changes on some sprites.

- Solved minor bugs.

- Now available in Spanish!

notes.title: v1.1: Leaderboards In Game + Solved Bug
notes.content:
- Now you can check Steam leaderboards in the game, just press R or SELECT (gamepad) in the main menu.

- This bug has been solved: When SUPER mode times out, if you are in a wall you still look like you are still in SUPER mode, but actually you are not.
